doc: Hash each id modulo `buckets` and return the one-hot matrix over buckets of shape (tokens, buckets).
name: hash_ids
reference:
def fn(ids, tokens, buckets):
    ids = ids.long().view(-1)
    b = ids.remainder(buckets)
    x = torch.zeros(tokens, buckets)
    x.scatter_(1, b.view(-1, 1), 1.0)
    return x

doc: One-hot of the ids (tokens, vocab) multiplied by a fixed seeded Gaussian sketch R (vocab, rank): returns X @ R of shape (tokens, rank).
name: sketch_onehot
reference:
def fn(ids, tokens, vocab, rank):
    ids = ids.long().view(-1)
    g = torch.Generator(device='cpu').manual_seed(1234)
    R = torch.randn(vocab, rank, generator=g) / (rank ** 0.5)
    x = torch.zeros(tokens, vocab)
    x.scatter_(1, ids.view(-1, 1), 1.0)
    return x @ R

doc: Project a one-hot of the ids through a seeded Gaussian sketch R (vocab, rank), entries N(0, 1/rank): returns X @ R.
name: sketch_proj
reference:
def fn(x, vocab, rank):
    import torch, torch.nn.functional as F
    g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(0)
    R = torch.randn(vocab, rank, generator=g) / (rank ** 0.5)
    X = F.one_hot(x.long().reshape(-1), vocab).float()
    return X @ R

doc: Soft one-hot over the vocabulary: weight 0.5 on the id itself and 0.5 on the next id (cyclically), shape (tokens, vocab).
name: soft_onehot
reference:
def fn(ids, tokens, vocab):
    ids = ids.long().view(-1)
    x = torch.zeros(tokens, vocab)
    x.scatter_(1, ids.view(-1, 1), 0.5)
    x.scatter_add_(1, (ids + 1).remainder(vocab).view(-1, 1), torch.full((tokens, 1), 0.5))
    return x

doc: Soft one-hot over the ids: weight 0.75 on the id itself, 0.25 on its cyclic neighbor (id+1) mod classes.
name: soft_onehot_build
reference:
def fn(x, classes):
    import torch, torch.nn.functional as F
    ids = x.long().reshape(-1)
    X = F.one_hot(ids, classes).float()
    Y = torch.zeros_like(X)
    Y[torch.arange(ids.numel()), (ids + 1) % classes] = 1.0
    return 0.75 * X + 0.25 * Y
